status: Qualified native request-local index orchestration, with bounded GPU primitive race-check scope. Full native attention, forward/model admission, end-to-end generation and vLLM parity remain open.

implementation.ownership: Mutable selection/candidate workspace and epochs belong to the session request. Core projection/parameter handles remain immutable backend-model resources. Shape, index-source, KV-owner and candidate rules come from model anatomy; no model family/layer names added to transformer orchestration.
implementation.setup: Additional exact device/host quotas, optional SWA on same FFN/KV request, shared reserved linear workspace, all index buffers allocated before execution. Transactional attach after stage completion, matching setup idempotent, live upgrades rejected. Permanently dense <=512-entry geometry has zero index device payload and needs no index compute callbacks.
implementation.publication: Begin snapshots private owner publication generations and expires old selections/masks even at identical positions. Selection requires owner cursor equal chunk end and a successful owner publication after begin. A private checked uint64 generation commits after publication completion; public KV view shape unchanged. Republishing at unchanged cursor invalidates cached results.
implementation.execution: Sliding and <=512-entry dense paths skip queries/scoring/selection. Producing index sources project once for the full chunk, then use source256/final-tail16 slabs (273 ->256+17). Ordinary top-k through16384 entries; larger pools use candidate-source masks then later candidate-use layers. Candidate masks cover the full chunk and share only while epoch/rate/entries/owner version match. Actual RoPE/query and per-slab causal positions preserved.
implementation.sharing: Readers borrow the latest matching source index buffer, with no GPU work or completion fence. A later producing source expires previous selection views. Source candidate masks survive later candidate-use selection while parent publication generation remains unchanged.
implementation.failure: Malformed scalar/view/dependency inputs reject before enqueue with unchanged outputs. Injected backend/completion failures destroy the entire request, invalidate borrowed views and require reset/setup. Model/session whole-forward position is not advanced.
implementation.hot_path: No logical resident allocation, host upload, device readback or resize inside index execution. One completion fence per producing full chunk; none for dense/sliding/shared readers.

reference.method: Unchanged full source _indexer_topk AST; independent paired-library query/raw-head-weight projections replayed from immutable prior capture, original RoPE/Triton/original top-k. Caller dense/shared rules from architecture configuration. Synthetic repeated canonical key history; KV latents not used by this index-only fixture.

metadata_oracle.method: Independent Python metadata/caller-mode and source-slab oracle; numerical values remain original source captures.

reference.scope: Checkpoint-derived x/normalized-q_res and immutable paired-library projection captures; original RoPE/Triton/top-k and unchanged full indexer AST. Synthetic repeated canonical key history with zero unused capacity and zero KV latents, not an actual full-prefix model execution.

verification.targeted_cpu_tests: Synthetic dispatch, dense/no-callback planning, exact quotas, allocation/completion rollback, source/readers/candidate sharing, pool-generation invalidation, invalid inputs, two-session isolation and reset.
verification.cuda_sanitizers: Full controller and combined index/SWA: memcheck with full leak checking and initcheck, all zero errors/leaks. Bounded original GPU primitive race fixtures: index/query24 calls, top-k160 calls, candidate-source64 calls, candidate-use44 calls, all zero hazards/errors/warnings.

full_controller_race.reason: Racecheck host RSS exceeded400GB on502GiB shared machine; swap19GiB nearly full, available63GiB before large R273 group. Stopped target before exhaustion. Not a race failure and not a pass.
full_controller_race.completed_through: group5 layer39; large group6 not qualified by full race run

verification.race_limit: Full controller race run stopped for shared-machine memory protection (>400GB host RSS, swap nearly full) before large R273 case. It is incomplete, not passed. GPU kernels unchanged in this controller change; bounded existing primitive race fixtures rerun on final build. Full R273 execution covered by exact normal/ASAN/memcheck/initcheck runs.

limits: Component/index session orchestration only; full native causal attention and attention output projections/Engram are not integrated or admitted.
Two independent sessions demonstrate isolation, not continuous batching or concurrent serving throughput.
Single traced candidate-use component call is not a throughput/latency benchmark or vLLM parity evidence. Existing scorer performance gap remains open.
Full model short/long/chunked/resumed prefill/decode, production frequency/controller metadata, whole-forward asynchronous stream coordination and end-to-end token references remain required.
